headline: This law names a post office in Alden, New York, after Sergeant Brett E. Gornewicz.
what_it_does: The law gives an official name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 13127 Broadway Street in Alden, New York. The facility will be called the "Sergeant Brett E. Gornewicz Memorial Post Office." The summary does not describe any other changes to how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on August 8, 2014.
